name: Cá bớp with lá lốt
summary: Cá bớp nấu lá lốt is a hot bowl at the Cái Dăm seafood table in Hạ Long. Báo Quảng Ninh, 9 Jul 2015, says each person had one fish in one bowl.
origin: Hạ Long, at the Cái Dăm meal in the 9 Jul 2015 account. The same paragraph also names the fish among plates for guests from the hills.
howToEat: Stewed with lá lốt, one fish to a bowl, served hot. A further seasoning was not printed.
A price was not printed. Check on arrival.
where: The Cái Dăm table in thành phố Hạ Long, on that account.
